title: Concept: Log line built with an explicit CRLF in javascript — review required
description: In javascript, a log call builds its message with a literal CRLF sequence. Many collectors split events on newlines, so the second half becomes an independent line that appears to come from the application itself. An attacker who controls any appended value can fabricate entries, hide activity, or poison downstream alerting without ever touching the log file.
applicability: javascript services that log request-derived values through text sinks.
risk: Log forgery and alerting evasion; MEDIUM severity.
